description: First hardware calibration campaign for the SISC continuity benchmarks.
rationale: ibm_fez has the lowest average two-qubit and readout errors among the initially listed Heron backends.
Phase 0 transpilation produced candidate circuits for all g0/g1/g2 schedules.
The first campaign should use a single backend to avoid mixing calibration conditions across amplification levels.

selected_jobs.purpose: Amplitude calibration and degeneracy-avoiding MLAE schedule.
Quadratic encoding continuity benchmark with moderate depth.

deferred_jobs.reason: Use only if we explicitly want to document the known k=1 degeneracy at a=1/4.
Keep as a repetition/depth-stress option after the first hardware readout.
Most expensive calibration circuit; defer until k=0,1 results are assessed.

stopping_rules: Do not submit deferred jobs until the first six selected jobs have been retrieved and analyzed.
If g1/g2 k=0 already show large bias inconsistent with noisy simulation, pause before deeper circuits.
If queue or backend status changes substantially, rerun Phase 0 for the selected backend before submission.
